test.lifecycle: The responsive size limits, corner radii, Flex child values and Grid child placement are asserted in the existing real Chromium Inspector → Canvas → Undo/Redo → draft Save/reload → separate Publish → public CSS parity flow.

registry_route_followup.assertions: For 57 fields in the shared lifecycle helper plus six fields in their existing dedicated lifecycle flows (background.color, typography.fontSize, typography.textAlign, spacing.padding, size.minWidth and typography.lineHeight), the rendered Inspector data-property-command and data-property-key are compared to the canonical property-registry command and key; explicit route expectations remain asserted too.
registry_route_followup.test_stability: Selection avoids re-clicking a node that is already selected; public CSS reads wait for the asynchronously rendered public node after reload.
registry_route_followup.lifecycle: All assertions run within the real Chromium Canvas → Undo/Redo → draft Save/reload → separate Publish → public CSS parity flow.

scope: Test and plan evidence only; no runtime, production data, migration or storage changes. The full 77.44.7.A acceptance remains open.
